title: Delta Solar — Production & Inverter Diagnostics
description: Delta M4-TL-US BLE collector: production, electrical measurements and data availability. InfluxDB 1.x / InfluxQL.

list.name: serial
list.label: Inverter
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "inverter_data" WITH KEY = "serial" WHERE "model" = 'M4-TL-US'
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "inverter_data" WITH KEY = "serial" WHERE "model" = 'M4-TL-US'

options.content:
**Delta M4-TL-US · Pacific time · ~60-second polling**

Recent power uses the last **5 minutes of wall-clock time**, independent of the date picker. Other panels use the selected range. **Reported energy counter** is the inverter's `DailyEnergy` value; reset behavior is unverified, so it is not a verified daily yield. Gaps mean missing readings, not zero production. Unsupported PV channels remain empty.

panels.title: Recent power · last 5 minutes
panels.description: Latest Power sample for each selected inverter within the last five minutes, independent of the dashboard time range. Missing series indicate no recent Power sample, not zero output.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("Power") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE time > now() - 5m AND time <= now() AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY "serial"

panels.title: Reported energy counter · latest in range
panels.description: Raw DailyEnergy counter in kWh. Reset behavior has not been verified. This is not a calculated today total; the last value may be old when an inverter is offline.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("DailyEnergy") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY "serial"

panels.title: AC production by inverter
panels.description: Mean power per display interval. Null intervals are not connected or replaced with zero.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("Power") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)

panels.title: Combined production · stacked observed power
panels.description: Stacked mean power of selected inverters. A missing inverter makes the visible stack incomplete; this is not a guaranteed whole-site total. Samples are asynchronous and averaged into common time buckets.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("Power") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)

panels.title: Reported energy counter trend
panels.description: Last DailyEnergy value in each interval. Counter drops may help establish reset behavior. Do not sum counter samples to calculate generation.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("DailyEnergy") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)
SELECT MEAN("ACVoltage") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)
SELECT MEAN("ACCurrent") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)
SELECT MEAN("ACFrequency") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)

panels.title: PV input voltage · $serial
panels.description: PV1–PV4 where supported. Empty channels mean the inverter did not report that field.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("PV1Voltage") AS "PV1", MEAN("PV2Voltage") AS "PV2", MEAN("PV3Voltage") AS "PV3", MEAN("PV4Voltage") AS "PV4" FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)

panels.title: PV input current · $serial
panels.description: PV1–PV4 where supported. Empty channels mean the inverter did not report that field.

targets.query: SELECT MEAN("PV1Current") AS "PV1", MEAN("PV2Current") AS "PV2", MEAN("PV3Current") AS "PV3", MEAN("PV4Current") AS "PV4" FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "serial" fill(null)

panels.title: Last Power measurement · selected range
panels.description: LAST(Power) without time grouping preserves the original sample timestamp. Select a wider range to locate older readings. A completed read can omit Power, so this is freshness of the Power field, not proof of collector health. The frame selector switches between inverter series if Grafana returns separate tables.

targets.query: SELECT LAST("Power") AS "Power (kW)" FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY "serial"

panels.title: Power samples received · per 5 minutes
panels.description: Count of stored Power samples, not polling success rate. Around five per complete bucket is typical with 60-second polling. Retries, missing Power fields and offline/nighttime devices reduce counts; spool replay can backfill old buckets. Edge buckets may be partial. Empty buckets are zero counts, not zero production.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT("Power") FROM "inverter_data" WHERE $timeFilter AND "model" = 'M4-TL-US' AND "serial" =~ /^${serial:regex}$/ GROUP BY time(5m), "serial" fill(0)
